import os
from pathlib import Path
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
key = Path(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read_text().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
out = Path('/workspace/run_trace/phykit_tree_lengths.tsv')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
gi.datasets.download_dataset('f9cad7b01a472135329845ea48174bd5', file_path=str(out), use_default_filename=False)
print(out)
PY
python - <<'PY'
import csv, statistics
from collections import defaultdict
p='/workspace/run_trace/phykit_tree_lengths.tsv'
vals=defaultdict(list)
with open(p, newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\\t'):
        if row['status']=='ok':
            vals[row['group']].append(float(row['value']))
a=statistics.median(vals['animals'])
f=statistics.median(vals['fungi'])
print('animals_count',len(vals['animals']))
print('fungi_count',len(vals['fungi']))
print('animals_median',format(a,'.15g'))
print('fungi_median',format(f,'.15g'))
print('fungi_over_animals',format(f/a,'.15g'))
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /workspace/codex_output && python - <<'PY'
import csv, os, statistics
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
key=open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
out='/workspace/codex_output/galaxy_phykit_tree_lengths.tsv'
gi.datasets.download_dataset('f9cad7b01a4721356010fc1eed39e45c', file_path=out, use_default_filename=False)
vals={'animals': [], 'fungi': []}
with open(out, newline='') as fh:
    for row in csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\\t'):
        if row['status']=='ok': vals[row['group']].append(float(row['value']))
for g in vals:
    vals[g].sort()
    print(g, len(vals[g]), format(statistics.median(vals[g]), '.17g'))
ratio=statistics.median(vals['fungi'])/statistics.median(vals['animals'])
print('fungi_over_animals', format(ratio, '.17g'))
PY"
